d: Chestnut brown hair is styled in a medium-length, voluminous bob with wispy bangs and a small ponytail, paired with olive green eyes behind gold-rimmed glasses on a face with a youthful, mature appearance. A slender build is dressed in a teal blazer over a grey pinstripe vest, a white collared shirt with a red bow tie, and a long dark navy skirt, all cinched at the waist by a wide, dark navy striped sash. The ensemble is topped with a wide-brimmed teal hat adorned with dark fabric folds and green-and-red feathers, complemented by dark brown lace-up oxfords with white frilled socks and a brown leather briefcase held in one hand.
